item.title: Nigeria vs Trump: US lawmakers storm major northern state
item.description: A prominent northern governor has hosted some lawmakers from the United States following Donald Trump's Christian genocide allegation against the FG.

item.title: My Colleague Blamed Me for Her Mistake at Work: I Had the Receipts and Got Her Job
item.description: When my colleague bypassed procedure and crashed a major client launch, she blamed me. I used the paper trail to expose her lies and ended up taking her promotion.

item.title: I Took What Didn’t Belong to Me And Lost My Closest Friend Because of It
item.description: Grief-stricken, I took my friend's heirloom watch for a night to reclaim a shared memory. I broke it, and the resulting betrayal cost me our lifelong friendship.

item.title: Tinubu's presidency: Powerful minister told to immediately resign, see why
item.description: A minister in President Bola Tinubu’s cabinet has been told to resign immediately amid claims of 'divided loyalty', adding a new twist to the insecurity issue.

item.title: I Thought Calling Him “Dad” Would Be Awkward — He Broke Down and Said “Yes, Please”
item.description: Ade fears naming the bond he’s always felt with Abioye. One quiet confession shatters years of hesitation and reveals a love waiting to be acknowledged.

item.title: She Tried To Keep My Home While Dating Someone Else — I Refused and She Packed Her Bags That Night
item.description: Jumoke clings to Ayo's house while drifting toward someone else. He refuses to be her safety net without commitment, forcing a choice that changes their lives.

item.title: China's trade surplus tops $1 trillion despite plunge in US-bound exports
item.description: China's towering annual trade surplus surpassed $1 trillion for the first time last month, data showed Monday, as a sharp drop in shipments to the United States was offset by surging exports to other major markets.

item.title: Watch video of Junior Pope's widow with Mercy Johnson that has sparked reactions online
item.description: Junior Pope's widow, Jennifer Awele, shared a viral video with Mercy Johnson. The fun clip sparked mixed reactions, with fans debating her move on after his death.

item.title: My Father Abandoned Me for Years — Now He’s Dying, I Read His Journal but Refused to Forgive
item.description: Adaeze faces the return of her estranged father, Emeka, as his illness worsens. When she reads his hidden journal, she confronts old wounds and refuses to forgive.

item.title: Video: Race to inherit Awujale stool heats up as KWAM 1 publicly declares intention on stage
item.description: KWAM 1 publicly declared his intention to inherit the Awujale stool, calling on the spirit of the late monarch and sparking reactions across Nigeria
